defect: The fix only reflows the NewSstFileManager declaration (bytes_max_delete_chunk already defaults to 0 by then); it repairs nothing this change added.
reason: The fix commit is about copying the block trailer in block_fetcher.cc; its edit to this header is pure formatting.

defect: The fix copies the block trailer together with the block in GetBlockContents; this change only added inline hints and switched to unique_ptr::reset without changing how many bytes are copied.
reason: The memcpy of only block_size_ bytes predates this change.

defect: The new PinnedUsageTest never releases the handles of odd-numbered inserts or the handles returned by Lookup, leaking cache entries (valgrind failure).
reason: The leaking lines are in the test added here, and the fix releases exactly those handles.

defect: InstallTimedWaitFixCallback is defined inline in the header and calls SyncPoint without including test_util/sync_point.h, and SyncPoint does not exist in NDEBUG builds, so the header does not compile on its own or in release builds.
reason: The fix moves exactly this added code out of line into a .cc file that includes sync_point.h and guards it with NDEBUG.

defect: The new member logger_ is never initialized in the DBImpl constructor (crash in c_test), and last_log_ts is a std::atomic that requires a C++0x compiler.
reason: Both members were added by this change; the fix initializes logger_ to NULL and drops the atomic.

defect: The fix adds a recovery flag so that unknown column families are ignored during WAL replay and the sequence number advances on skipped updates; in this file it only passes the new argument.
reason: This change only made InsertInto take log_number; the unadvanced sequence on skipped updates already existed, and the unknown-column-family error came from a later change.

defect: PutCF, MergeCF and DeleteCF now return InvalidArgument for an unknown column family even during WAL recovery, so replaying a log that references a dropped column family fails recovery.
reason: Before this change unknown column families were silently skipped; the fix restores that behaviour for recovery through a recovery flag.

defect: In the coroutine MultiGet path an error from MultiGetFilter breaks out of the loop, and the new s.ok() guard skips running already queued tasks that hold table cache handles, so those handles leak.
reason: The early break and the s.ok() condition on running mget_tasks were added here; the fix runs the queued coroutines regardless of the status.

defect: Read-only open now replays the WAL into the memtable (GetMemTable and external_table) instead of writing L0 files, but DBImplReadOnly::Get and NewIterator still read only SST files, so recent writes are missed and ldb sees the second-latest value.
reason: The memtable-recovery plumbing was introduced by this change; the fix makes read-only Get and NewIterator consult the memtable through GetMemTable and a protected NewInternalIterator.

defect: DBImplReadOnly::NewIterator dereferences options.snapshot unconditionally, crashing when no snapshot is given, which is the default.
reason: The new file added this dereference, and the fix falls back to the latest sequence when options.snapshot is null.

defect: In this file the fix changes NULL to nullptr and makes read-only commands use OpenForReadOnly; it does not repair the NoDBOpen and CloseDB lines added here.
reason: The fix's edits to this file are style and a feature switch tied to a read-only-mode fix elsewhere.

defect: LevelFileNumIterator::value() now exposes the raw bytes of a whole FileMetaData as the index value, so TwoLevelIterator compares uninitialized padding and mutable fields such as refs (valgrind error, possible wrong block reuse).
reason: This change introduced passing FileMetaData as the block handle; the fix replaces it with a small, fully initialized EncodedFileMetaData.

defect: The new GetOptionsFromStringTest compares the int max_write_buffer_number with 16U and the size_t block_size with 4, signed/unsigned comparisons that break the -Werror build on Mac.
reason: The offending assertions were added here, and the fix only changes their literal suffixes.

defect: SetBytesPerSync writes 8MB values, so without compression every buffer flush exceeds both bytes_per_sync settings and the RangeSync count is not lower for the larger setting, making the test fail.
reason: The fix message says the failures started with this PR, and it shrinks the value size and pins kNoCompression in exactly the test added here.

defect: uint32_t actual is left uninitialized on the unknown-checksum path, producing a maybe-uninitialized warning that fails the -Werror build.
reason: The switch with the uninitialized local was added here, and the fix only initializes it to 0.

defect: The fix avoids taking &range_del_iters[0] of an empty vector; at this change the vector held one entry per memtable, and it only became possibly empty when a later commit pushed only non-null tombstone iterators.
reason: The empty-vector case was created by fd43ee09d, not by this change.

defect: ShuttingDownNotBlockStalledWrites delays compaction only by a fixed 2-second sleep instead of ordering it after the shutdown, so compaction can unblock the stalled write first and the expected ShutdownInProgress status is flaky.
reason: The fix reworks only the sync-point dependencies of this newly added test to make the ordering deterministic.

defect: The fix changes the bytes_read variables from int64_t to size_t to avoid a signed/unsigned comparison on Windows; the int64_t types and the comparison already existed before this change.
reason: This change only replaced the local env with env_ and kept the types that cause the Windows error.

defect: The fix allows a null option type map and makes GetOptionsPtr see inner options of wrapped Customizables; this change only removed the invoke_prepare_options check in PrepareOptions.
reason: The null-map handling is a new capability unrelated to the lines changed here.

defect: The fix adds GetOptionsPtr delegation to Inner() and extends these test classes to register options and test it.
reason: The test lines added here are not defective; the fix extends them to cover a new capability.

defect: The updated assertion expects 9 deletions counted only through DeleteTrashFile, but the delete scheduler sometimes deletes files directly, so the count is flaky (and two files are actually deleted).
reason: The fix message attributes the flakiness to this PR (#3544) and corrects the counting and the expected value of the assertion changed here.

defect: VerifyTableProperties compares the int literal 4 with props.size() (size_t), a signed/unsigned comparison that breaks -Werror builds.
reason: The line was added here, and the fix only changes 4 to 4U.

defect: The fix adds a kConcurrentSkipList option configuration to test concurrent memtable writes; the ShouldSkipOptions refactor done here is not repaired.
reason: The fix's edit to this file is new test coverage for a bug elsewhere.

defect: The fix inserts kConcurrentSkipList into the OptionConfig enum and moves kEnd; the kRecycleLogFiles entry added here is unchanged.
reason: This is a test-configuration extension, not a repair of this change.

defect: The fix generalizes the reopen-vote check to compare with the previous loop index so that iterations doing several operations, such as iterator seeks, are handled; the MultiGet-based check added here was correct for the operations that existed then.
reason: The fix message says a later option for multiple iterator seeks per iteration broke the logic again.

defect: This change lets a cancelled manual compaction return before the background compaction finishes (shared_ptr state), and the new DisableJustStartedManualCompaction test encodes that ordering, so re-enabling manual compaction can revive a cancelled background job.
reason: The fix makes the foreground wait for the background job or its unscheduling and adjusts the sync-point dependency of the test added here.

defect: The fix makes DBTest.SoftLimit wait for the flush job context cleanup before checking the stall listener; this change only reformatted WriteStallListener.
reason: The race in SoftLimit existed before; this change touched only whitespace there.

defect: The new --level0_slowdown_writes_trigger flag defaults to 4 instead of the library default 8, so db_bench slows writes earlier; the fix restores 8.
reason: The fix calls it a regression, but a benchmark flag default may have been an intended tuning choice, so it is unclear whether this is a defect or configuration.

defect: The new default target_file_size_multiplier of 10, together with the per-level sizing in version_set.cc, makes file and level targets grow per level instead of the previous fixed 2MB files and 10MB level-1 limit, regressing compaction triggering.
reason: The change was meant only to make constants configurable; the fix restores the old behaviour by setting the multiplier to 1 and sizing level 1 like level 0.

defect: WriteRecoverableState takes LastSequence as the base sequence, but with two write queues (concurrent_prepare) allocated sequences can be ahead of LastSequence, so the recoverable state gets sequence numbers that overlap already allocated ones.
reason: The fix replaces exactly this LastSequence base with the last allocated sequence when two write queues are used.

defect: The #if combines defined(__GLIBC_PREREQ) and __GLIBC_PREREQ(2, 12) in one expression, which fails to preprocess when __GLIBC_PREREQ is not defined, breaking builds without glibc.
reason: The fix, whose Blame Rev names this commit, splits the condition into nested #if lines.

defect: The new log message prints a uint64_t with %lu, a format mismatch that fails the -Werror build on MacOS, where uint64_t is unsigned long long.
reason: The Log call was added here, and the fix switches it to PRIu64.

defect: The new perf test prints uint64_t values with %lu, which fails -Wformat -Werror builds on MacOS.
reason: All the format strings the fix changes were added in this change.

defect: BlockReader now returns a heap-allocated error iterator for no-IO cache misses, but InternalGet breaks out of the loop on Incomplete without deleting block_iter, leaking the iterator.
reason: Before this change nullptr was returned, so nothing leaked; the fix wraps block_iter in a unique_ptr.

defect: MultiRead injects and counts an error both for individual requests and for the overall return status, so the stress test's injected-error count can exceed the observed failures and report a false positive.
reason: The bug-fix part of the later commit stops counting the overall injection when a per-request error was injected, in the MultiRead added here.

defect: The CorruptionDuringBackup callback sets a plain bool corrupted from backup worker threads while it is read elsewhere, a data race that TSAN reports.
reason: Blame shows the bool line comes from this change, and the fix makes it std::atomic<bool>.

defect: ModelDB::Close() is declared virtual without override while every other member uses override, triggering -Winconsistent-missing-override and breaking the clang -Werror build.
reason: The line was added here, and the fix only adds override.

defect: The fix skips SetIdentityFile in SetDBId for read-only DBs; that unconditional IDENTITY write was moved here unchanged from DBImpl::Recover.
reason: The behaviour predates this change, which only extracted the code into SetDBId.

defect: The fix stops a read-only DB from writing the IDENTITY file when write_dbid_to_manifest is set and extends OpenBackupAsReadOnlyDB to cover that case.
reason: The test lines added here are not wrong; the repaired write comes from older code in SetDBId.

defect: The fix lowers max_bytes_for_level_base in ReduceDBLevels from 1L << 60 to 1UL << 50 alongside test adjustments; 1L << 60 fits the uint64_t option and is not shown to cause a failure.
reason: The test failure the fix addresses came from the reduce-levels logic change, not from this compile fix.
